offence_note: Robbery with knife, masked face, weapon (syringe) dangerous purpose
sentence_quote: For the charge pursuant to section 344 of the Criminal Code I sentence you to incarceration in a federal institution for a period of 54 months.
note: Other counts concurrent; 54 months less 551 days to serve.

offence_note: Fishing outside licensed area under Fisheries Act
sentence_quote: In my view, a fine of $1000 is in line with established precedent in this area, and consistent with the principles of proportionality and deterrence.
note: Six months to pay; no victim surcharge under Fisheries Act.

offence_note: Unlawful confinement of son (substituted for attempted abduction); assault of boy
sentence_quote: I would also affirm the sentence passed by the trial court, which I find to be a fit sentence in relation to the charges of unlawful confinement and assault on which the appellant now stands convicted.
note: Conviction appeal dismissed with substituted conviction; sentence not appealed, affirmed; 30 days concurrent for assault.

offence_note: Robbery, theft, mischief, breaches of undertaking; probation terms appealed
sentence_quote: Crown counsel also advised us that the mandatory arms prohibition order that is required after the robbery conviction was overlooked in the trial court. We added that order to the order made in this appeal as well.
note: Jail already served (just over seven months total); probation conditions varied, residence at Seven Oaks at probation officer's direction.

offence_note: Three sexual assaults; dangerous offender designation
sentence_quote: We are not persuaded there was any error in the trial judge declaring the appellant a dangerous offender.

offence_note: Sexual assault of 10-year-old girl; dangerous offender
sentence_quote: I declare that Mr. Angers is a dangerous offender and I impose a sentence of detention in a penitentiary for an indeterminate period.

offence_note: Possession of methamphetamine for purpose of trafficking
sentence_quote: The sentence of five years for drugs with a street value of approximately $200,000 was not unreasonable.
note: Five years less eight months credit for onerous bail conditions.

offence_note: Aggravated assault, assault causing bodily harm, weapon, obstruction, breaches
sentence_quote: ive years imprisonment followed by a ten-year supervision order
note: Crown appeal allowed: six years conventional replaced by five years plus 10-year LTSO; ancillary orders stand.

offence_note: Assault of fiancee; breach of recognizance
sentence_quote: this is an appropriate case for the grant of a conditional discharge.
note: Replaced one-day sentences after 10 months pre-trial custody with conditional discharge.

sentence_quote: to a period of eight years federal incarceration; on the charge of attempted murder specific to Thomas Henry Baker, a period of five years consecutive.
note: Eight years manslaughter plus five years consecutive; healing centre portion recommended.
